failure_modes.recovery: Send q with a word from the buyer's name or TIN.

description: Find registered buyers by text: every word must match one of the buyer's text fields, such as name, TIN, BRN, email or address. Refuses an empty q with VALIDATION_ERROR. No match returns an empty list: call myinvois_customer_create to register the buyer. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_generate with the id as customer_id.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.

q.description: Search text (substring match over the entity's text properties; %/_ are literal).

name: myinvois_customer_search
